set.body:
Establish executable laws before changing the public algebra.

Acceptance:
- Add semantic GenPCA accessors or result types for column axes, metric loadings, row axes, principal scores, eigenvalues or singular values, and row-dual quantities.
- Verify both transport equations with documented absolute and relative residuals.
- Verify row and column metric orthonormality and nonzero-spectrum agreement.
- Verify weighted reconstruction error against the discarded spectrum and deterministic competing rank-k reconstructions for SPD geometry.
- Verify covariance under deterministic invertible row and column basis changes.
- Verify double transpose and GenPCA transpose exchange.
- Compare repeated or clustered eigenvalues by subspace or projector, not component columns.
- Preserve the existing R fixtures and eigen versus deflation parity.
- Run all new tests from shared sources on JVM and Scala.js.

Non-goal: no large public type migration in this slice.
set.title: multivar constitution: GPCA law harness and semantic result contract
